āḷhaka.p:
[Ā+hana+ṇvu] (pu) CL=8 Elephant pole. Āḷaka- see also. Āḷhaka(pu,na) [aha+ṇvu(ālaka-saṃ)]  Prañña (unit of grain measure equivalent to four Calaya).
(Calaya means unit of grain measure equivalent to o.0175 of a bushel).
a: ဆင်ချည်တိုင်။ အာဠက-လည်းကြည့်။ āḷhaka အာဠှက(ပု၊န) [အဟ+ဏွု(အာလက-သံ)] ပြည်(လေးစလယ်)။

P: Āḷhaka，（m. & nt.） [Sk. āḍhaka，fr. *āḍha probably meaning “grain”] a certain measure of capacity，originally for grain； in older texts usually applied to a liquid measure （udaka°）. Its size is given by Bdhgh. at SnA 476 as follows：“cattāro patthā āḷhakāni doṇaṁ etc.” -- udakāḷhaka S.V，400； A.II，55 = III，337； VvA.155. -- In other connections at J.I，419 （aḍḍh°）； III，541 （mitaṁ āḷhakena = dhañña-māpaka-kammaṁ kataṁ C.）； Miln.229 （patt°）； DhA.III，367 （aḍḍh°）. --thālikā a bowl of the capacity of an āḷhaka Vin.I，240； A.III，369； DhA.III，370 （v. l. bhatta-thālikā）. （Page 110）
C: āḷhaka：m. n. [Sk. āḍhaka] 阿羅迦，升[容量器具的單位]. -thālikā 一升瓶.

DOP: 1 āḷhaka m.n. [ S. āḍhaka], a fluid and dry measure ; Abh 482 (~o caturo patthā); 484 (~o nitthiyaṃ tumbho); Vin III 62, 3 (~aṃ sappiṃ tulaṃ guḷaṃ doṇaṃ taṇḍulaṃ āharāpetvā); Ja III 541, 22* (mitam ~ena; 542, 11´ : dhaññamāpakaṃ pi kira tena kataṃ); Ap 20, 30 (sakkā samudde udakaṃ pametuṃ ~ena vā); Sp 858, 1 (patthena nāḷiyā ~enā ti); Spk I 218, 28 (cattāro patthā ~aṃ, cattāri ~āni doṇaṃ); — °- thālikā , f. , a cooking-pot holding an āḷhaka of rice ; Vin I 240, 10 ; A III 369, 7 .
CPD: 2 āḷhaka , m., prob, a dial, variation of 1 alaka, the post to which an elephant is secured; ālānaṃ ~ o thambho, Abh 364; hatthiṃ tattha rataṃ ñatvā akaṃsu tattha ~ aṃ, Mhv XlX 73; nāgo bhetvāna ~ aṃ, ib. XXXV 24; hatthi ~ -samīpamhi kato . . . Hatth' ~ -vihāro, ib. XlX 83.
NCP: masculine neuter a | aa.lhaka fluid and dry measure.

āḷhakathālikā.p:
[Āḷhaka+thālikā] (thī) CL=8 pot with a capacity for cooking one Prañña of rice,   Rice cooker which can cook one Prañña of rice.
(Prañña means unit of grain measure equivalent to four Calaya).
a: အာဠှကထာလိကာ(ထီ)
ပြည်ဝင်အိုး၊ တပြည်ချက်ထမင်းအိုး။

Vin l 240, 10-25 = 241, 16 ; ~ aṃ purato katvā sakala-Jambudīpa-vāsinaṃ bhat- taṃ dentiyā, Dhp-a lll 370, 1 .
